newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi opens up on drugs study.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi opens up on drugs study.

text.p: Shares in drugs group Sanofi opened 2.13 percent higher at 480 francs on Thursday, after suspension on Wednesday afternoon, on the back of a positive study for a new blood clot drug.
The American Heart Association was presented with a study on Wednesday evening showing that Sanofi's clopidogrel was more effective than aspirin in many treatments for heart patients.
Sanofi and Bristol-Myers Squibb plan to register the drug in the U.S. and Europe in the first quarter of 1997.
Sanofi is majority-owned by Elf Aquitaine.
